units.source_text: 评判尚未总结，天色已入黑夜。

en.t: Before the judging had been summed up, night had already fallen.

units.source_text: 赛画轮到最后一次时，左方捧出了须磨画卷，权中纳言看了，不觉心中发怔。

en.t: When the picture contest reached its final round, the Left brought out the Suma picture scroll, and the Acting Middle Counselor, seeing it, was involuntarily struck dumb at heart.

units.source_text: 右方也曾煞费苦心，精选最优秀者作为最后一卷。

en.t: The Right too had taken great pains, choosing its finest work as the final scroll.

units.source_text: 谁知源氏公子画技异常高明，况且是在蛰居时专心一志、从容不迫地仔细画成的，故其优秀无可比拟。

en.t: Yet Prince Genji's skill in painting proved extraordinarily refined, and because he had made the scroll carefully during his seclusion, with single-minded concentration and unhurried calm, its excellence was beyond comparison.

units.source_text: 自帅皇子以下，都感动得流下泪来。

en.t: From the Commander Prince on down, everyone was so moved that they shed tears.

units.source_text: 众人看了这画卷，但觉孤栖独处之状，伤心落魄之情，历历如在目前，

en.t: As the people looked at this scroll, the sight of his lonely dwelling and solitary life, and the feeling of his grief and desolation, seemed to stand vividly before their eyes,

units.source_text: 比当年遥念他流放须磨之苦楚，为他怜惜悲伤时感动更深。

en.t: moving them even more deeply than when they had once thought from afar of the suffering of his exile at Suma and had pitied and grieved for him.

units.source_text: 那地方的光景，见所未见的各浦各矶，历尽无遗地画出。

en.t: The scenery of that place, with every unfamiliar inlet and rocky shore, was painted in full, leaving nothing out.

units.source_text: 各处写着变体的草书汉字和假名的题词。

en.t: Here and there were inscriptions written in variant cursive Chinese characters and kana.

units.source_text: 不是用汉文写的正式的详细日记，而是在记叙中夹着富有风趣的诗歌，令人百看不厌。

en.t: It was not a formal, detailed diary written in Chinese prose; instead, graceful poems were woven into the account, making it something one could look at again and again without tiring.

units.source_text: 看了这画，谁也没有考虑他事的余暇了。

en.t: After seeing this picture, no one had any leisure left to think of anything else.

units.source_text: 刚才过目的所有画卷便觉无味，众人兴致全然集中于须磨画卷，深感兴味津津。

en.t: All the scrolls they had just examined now seemed dull, and everyone's interest gathered wholly on the Suma scroll, which they found deeply absorbing.

units.source_text: 结果这画压倒一切，左方得胜。

en.t: In the end, this painting overwhelmed all the rest, and the Left side won.
